{{Quote|The treaty between the two worlds was automatically extended every ten years. This year, Crion called for a renegotiation. I found out later that it was a ruse, a way to delay until he could raise an army. A '''treaty''' had been established between the world of [[Telos IV]] and a neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the waning decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The treaty between the two worlds was automatically reconducted every ten [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]], but in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], the then–[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Telos [[Crion]] called for a renegotiation. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] tasked [[Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to oversee the meetings, and the Jedi discovered the negotiations were a cover for Crion's true intent: gaining a stranglehold of the neighboring planet and its valuable [[Mining/Legends|mines]] and factories.
